tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Generate ONE isolated full-body Chinese Bleak sprite on a genuinely transparent RGBA canvas. Fresh redraw of the EXACT adopted little fish in image1, an identity/style/colour reference only, not pixel edit target. Keep adopted blue-grey back, broad horizontal blue band, pale cream belly, brown dot eye, small smiling mouth, warm clean brown outlines and subtle clipped paper-watercolor texture. Preserve exact oval fish head/body length-width proportions, single dorsal fin, single forked tail, the existing one near pectoral fin and two lower fins. GREETING pose only: slightly lift the EXISTING near pectoral fin as a gentle greeting; body at rest, gaze friendly. No added fins, hands or human arms. No disconnected motion curves, extra brown lines, arrows, ripples, splashes, bubbles or marks on belly or outside character. The reference's fin veins are pale bounded interior lines only, no dark action marks. Full silhouette complete with generous truly transparent padding. Keep all other anatomy and painted colours close to adopted normal pose. Highest available native detail. No text, props, shadows, glow, backdrop, paper rectangle or gradients behind character. Watercolour/paper texture clipped strictly inside subject; all canvas corners/background alpha0, no broad low-alpha colour field.
